answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to one sealed cargo crate received at a licensed harbor jetty. An independent customs broker watches the handoff and seals a GPS thread-log of the route; one broker clears one crate per day, so seats cannot be bulk-bought or run in parallel. Random comet audits then summon any holder to the depot in person within hours, and missing a summons burns the bond. Fees are paid in outside money and double per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real crate, another broker day, another courier, and twice the prior fee.
